answer: Neighborhood overlap scoring measures shared neighbors rather than credentials. Each agent's history leaves an ivory trail of counterparties, and a new identity must accrue genuinely distinct neighbors that don't overlap existing clusters. Clones bought in bulk sit in one ocean of mutual adjacency, so the score collapses and their reach stays local. An attacker pays real interaction latency and distinct counterparties per identity, a wide haven of authentic ties that faking cannot shortcut.
